comparison.objective: Stow three cases while keeping every case off a glass surface.
comparison.physical_skill: Multi-object transport and placement with load-bearing surface selection and collision avoidance.

comparison.reason: Discrete case stowage and protected-surface avoidance are different from dry screening and recovery. No material rubric detail is missing.
